name: Mo-sin-a
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Mo-sin-a, the small hairy humanlike mountain spirit of Taiwan that lures travellers away.
ANATOMY: ONE very SHORT HAIRY humanlike creature with ONE head, TWO eyes, TWO arms and TWO legs, dense dark fur, adult humanlike face, no pointed ears/horns/fangs; opaque matted fur hides body. [mo-sin-a-c01]
MOMENT: Crouch on a tree root and beckon viewer with one bent hand while backing toward a cave, narrow intense ordinary eyes and a secretive predatory expression, lowered brow and taut lips. NO huge baby eyes, no round cute face, no grin or pet-like pose.
POWER: No transformation effects invented; documented beckoning/luring into remote mountain forest and caves, ordinary mist only. [mo-sin-a-c02,mo-sin-a-c05]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low close angle, subject fills80% of square; natural scale unless giant explicitly documented. Important features clear at200pixels.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one dominant cold moonlight through a gap in the clouds, strong rim light, deep walnut shadows, ordinary physical dust/moisture.
SURFACE: tactile natural fur/skin/scales where appropriate, coarse opaque textiles, rough stone, original visible painterly brushwork.
SETTING: Taiwan mountain forest and cave mouth, normal fern fronds above its shoulders establish very small size. [mo-sin-a-c02,mo-sin-a-c05]
MOOD: dangerous for hostile beings, awe-inspiring and respectful for gods/guardians, uncanny audacious for benign small spirits, never cute/calm/decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text/lettering/logo/border/frame/watermark; no extra heads/limbs/fingers; no borrowed film/game/anime/comic design; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outlines, energy ribbons, floating runes.

rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

visual_review.notes: Native1254,200 and foot crop inspected: small densely hairy humanlike spirit c01, one head/two eyes/two arms/two legs, opaque matted hair conceals body, front foot has five toes. Five-digit beckoning hand and wary adult face lure viewer toward mountain cave c02/c05; tiny scale relative ferns, no giant size. Uncanny intent reads at200, no cute pet look, horns/extra limbs/transformation visuals/text/aura/gore. Seven Sangar checks pass.

root_visual_review.notes: Viewed native 1254px, 200px, and face, beckoning-hand, rock-hand and brightened lower-body/foot crops. One short, hairy, humanlike Mo-sin-a (mo-sin-a-c01) has one head and two eyes. It has an adult, weathered human face with a lowered brow, a narrow sidelong stare and taut lips, secretive and predatory with no cute features. Dense, matted dark hair covers the whole body opaquely. Two arms: the extended hand beckons the viewer (thumb, crooked index and three curled fingers, five digits), and the other hand rests on a rock behind it. Two legs in a crouch. The front bare foot has five toes and grips a root. The second leg is folded under the body; in deep shadow its knee or heel and its toes show dimly, with no extra limb. It crouches on roots beside a black cave mouth in moonlit Taiwanese mountain forest. Fern fronds above its head make it small (it lures people to remote mountain forests and caves, c02/c05). No transformation effects, no Little-Girl-in-Red borrowing, no text or aura. At 200px the beckoning hand and the stare beside the cave mouth read as an uncanny lure, not a pet or an ordinary person.
